calls.reason: The GPT-3 training paper lists English Wikipedia, sampled about 3.4 times, and a January 2019 Wikipedia revision already described the Sally-Anne test. Repeated exposure is very likely.
This is an open-ended forecast with no deadline. No scrubbed-corpus retraining of GPT-3 has been found, and no event has made one impossible.
The only source is the authors' own tally, with no independent audit. Its 157-test and 80-test sets also undercut the claim that all examples were rerun.
SpartQA and PIQA show that spatial and physical benchmarks existed. No independent audit sets out what the February 2023 inventory covered, so the evidence is mixed.
Bang et al. and Sap et al. show spatial and social failures. But temporal results were fairly strong and Kosinski reported 93% on false-belief tasks, so the evidence is mixed.
OpenAI's InstructGPT paper reports overall preference and truthfulness gains over GPT-3, plus regressions on SQuAD, DROP, HellaSwag and WMT translation.
